brand.name: AuraOS
brand.theme_archetype: Airy macOS Frosted Glass & Tactical Intelligence

layout_architecture.container: relative w-full h-screen overflow-hidden bg-cover bg-center flex flex-col font-sans antialiased select-none

left_rail.icon_bar: w-[64px] h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-between py-5 bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border-r border-white/40 shadow-sm z-30
left_rail.history_panel: w-[276px] h-full flex flex-col bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-white/30 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-6

center_panel.width: flex-1 h-full flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden bg-white/30 backdrop-blur-md border-r border-white/30 shadow-inner

right_panel.width: w-[420px] flex-shrink-0 h-full flex flex-col bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-2xl p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 border-l border-white/40 shadow-xl
sections: Approval Review Box (Approve, Reject, Edit Invalidation)

conversation_panel.empty_state: Floating orb logo + 'Good morning, Alex / How can I help you today?' + suggestion chips
conversation_panel.attention_view: Tabs (All, High, Medium, Low) + per-person rows with action triggers

contextual_right_panel.draft_editor: Recipient chip list (e.g. #development-team), textarea draft, Attach & Rewrite pills, Send -> Sending -> Sent state machine
contextual_right_panel.approval_workflow: Approve / Reject buttons, Edit mode (marking draft edited invalidates prior approval)

demo_badge.label: Demo — sample data, nothing is sent
demo_badge.placement: Top center status bar + Right panel header

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive and status element MUST have a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case

accessibility_and_motion.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1 text contrast) over translucent glass backgrounds using solid text shades (#0F172A, #1E293B)
accessibility_and_motion.motion: Support prefers-reduced-motion, use crisp Framer Motion micro-interactions with smooth ease-out curves
accessibility_and_motion.keyboard_focus: Explicit ring-2 ring-blue-500 focus-visible styles on all interactive inputs and buttons
